meta.name: api-design-principles
meta.description: Master REST and GraphQL API design principles to build intuitive, scalable, and maintainable APIs that delight developers. Use when designing new APIs, reviewing API specifications, or establishing API design standards.

copy.tagline: 设计直观可扩展的接口规范
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在设计或评审 API 接口,需要一套最佳实践。
copy.tagline_en: Design intuitive, scalable REST and GraphQL APIs using proven principles
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are designing new APIs or setting API design standards.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 在设计或审查 API 时会套用 REST 与 GraphQL 的设计原则,就资源命名、HTTP 方法语义、版本策略、分页和错误格式给出建议。
howto.when: 当你在设计新的 REST 或 GraphQL API、审查 API 规范,或为团队制定 API 设计标准时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个用户订单的 REST API,给出资源路径和 HTTP 方法。
say.note: 会按 REST 原则给命名与方法建议

say.text: 审查一下这个 GraphQL schema,指出分页或 N+1 的问题。
say.note: 会对照 GraphQL 实践逐条检查

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude applies REST and GraphQL design principles when you design or review APIs, covering resource naming, HTTP method semantics, versioning, pagination, and error formats.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you design a new REST or GraphQL API, review API specifications before implementation, or set API design standards for a team.

say_en.text: Design a REST API for user orders, with resource paths and HTTP methods.
say_en.note: Gives REST naming and method advice

say_en.text: Review this GraphQL schema and flag pagination or N+1 issues.
